newsitem.title: BELARUS: SOCCER-MCALLISTER PENALTY GIVES SCOTLAND NARROW WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MCALLISTER PENALTY GIVES SCOTLAND NARROW WIN.

text.p: A Gary McAllister penalty in the 50th minute gave Scotland a 1-0 World Cup qualifying win over Belarus on Sunday but goalkeeper Jim Leighton was the hero for his injury-hit side.
The breakthrough arrived arrived after Hibs striker Darren Jackson was clumsily fouled in the box, giving the Scotland captain the chance to decide the European zone group four clash.

Belarus, anchored at the bottom of the group, fought well in the first half with Scotland facing a strong wind. They forced Leighton into some fine saves, including two free kicks turned on to the post.
Scotland recovered but apart from occasional forays by Jackson, rarely threatened..
Belaruis might count themselves unfortunate not to have forced an equaliser in a final 10 minutes of pressure during which Leighton was again at the fore.
The Scots extended their lead over second-placed Austria to seven points from eight games.
But Austria and Sweden, another point behind, face Latvia and Estonia respectively later on Sunday and will both still have two games in hand after that.
